messages:
Gabe: Heads-up everyone  Talia's birthday is next Wednesday (6/9). Thinking of a tiny morning desk-decor parade at 9:05am + a roaming coffee cart at 10:30am. Remote folks we'll send an e-gift and play any short vids during the toast. Thoughts? :confetti_ball:
people-ops-bot: FYI budget tag: `POPS-60`. React with :balloon: for desk-decor parade, :coffee: for coffee cart, or :sushi: for lunch sushi. Poll open until Tue 4pm.
Nina: Love the parade idea. I can lead the decoration crew and bring a roll of banner paper + tape.
Ibrahim: Coffee cart sounds amazing  I can coordinate with the vendor. We could do a matcha/latte + two non-dairy milks.
Ellie: I'm remote but can record a 20s silly birthday chant to play. Also happy to chip in $15 for e-gift.
Rae: Quick dietary/office note: Talia is allergic to shellfish (no sushi please) and prefers caffeinated coffee.
Gabe: Thanks Rae. Noted shellfish allergy. If sushi is off the table we'll default to coffee cart + pastries.
Nina: I'll order two small boxes of GF pastries too. Anyone want to contribute to a nicer gift card?
Zane: I'll add $10. Also volunteering to hide the gift on her desk at 8:50am (sneaky mode on).
Ibrahim: Vendor options  option A: local cart (latte + matcha + oat/almond milk) $120 for 40 cups. option B: catered Keurig + pastries $75. Vote with reactions.
people-ops-bot: Poll created  react to vote.
Ellie: :thumbsup: option A if budget allows.
Rae: option A works for me (more fun).
Gabe: If we do A, can we please have hot water for tea too?
Ibrahim: I'll request hot water. Also will confirm no foam topping on oat milk to avoid spill mess.
Nina: I'll bring scissors, tape, a small helium balloon (foil), and signs. Reminder: foil balloons only (latex causes issues).
Zane: I've got a spare camera phone for photos. I'll upload to #memes after.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled Wed 8:45am: "Place Talia's desk surprise".
Ellie: Sent the video clip. Also please DM me e-gift amount.
Gabe: Final logistics  desk team meet at 8:30am by the supply closet, vendor arrives 10:15am, parade at 9:05am. Who can be parade marshals?
Nina: I'll marshal left flank.
Zane: Right flank here.
Ibrahim: I'll coordinate the vendor and be at the cart at 10:10am.
Rae: I can do crowd control and hand out napkins.
people-ops-bot: Donation tracker updated. Gift extras so far: $25.
Gabe: Perfect. Remote folks we'll DM the e-gift and post the group photo. Thanks team! :tada:
